fields.name: key1
fields.label: Key
fields.description: Matched with the 2nd argument of lookup(), e.g. a grade, level, or job profile. Empty = any (default row)

fields.name: key2
fields.label: Key 2
fields.description: Optional second key, e.g. location. Empty = any

fields.name: from_value
fields.label: From (≥)
fields.description: For lookup_range(): lower bound, inclusive. Empty = no lower bound

fields.name: to_value
fields.label: Up to (<)
fields.description: For lookup_range(): upper bound, exclusive. Empty = no upper bound

fields.name: amount
fields.label: Amount / rate
fields.description: Amount (e.g. 25000 per day) or rate (e.g. 10 for 10%)

fields.name: valid_from
fields.label: Valid from
fields.description: Rows with the latest date on or before the payroll period end are used together; empty = from the start
